personality_one_liner: A modern, highly legible fintech-style grocery tracker with fresh green accents and crisp white space.

spacing.rule: Use generous iOS-native rhythms. Padding around cards should be lg (16pt), lists must have 56pt tappable height. Margins must separate semantic sections cleanly.

do_s: Use glass on bottom tab bar.
Use glass on sticky headers when lists scroll behind.
Use glass on Floating Action Buttons (FAB).
dont_s: Do not use glass on form inputs or standard list rows.
Do not use glass over plain white backgrounds (loses effect).

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Authenticate users securely via Google Auth with a fresh, welcoming grocery tracker vibe.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background hero image (fresh fruits/veggies) with a heavy gradient-to-dark scrim (top-to-bottom, ending at 90% surfaceInverse). Display bold app name and one-liner at bottom 30%, followed by a sticky Google Login button (white pill) at the safe area bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Give users an instant snapshot of monthly spending and quick access to recent logged items.

states.loading: Skeleton of summary card and 3 list rows.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty cart, 'No purchases this month', Add Purchase CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky Header with 'Despensa' and total balance summary card (Fintech style: large number, selected currency, monthly breakdown). Below, a 'Recent Transactions' feed (date, market, total). Floating Action Button (FAB) in brand color with glass for adding expenses/scanning.

screens.name: ScanReceipt
screens.purpose: Capture supermarket receipts via camera for OCR data extraction.

states.error: Permission denied error or scan failed message with manual entry fallback.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera modal. Semi-transparent overlay with a clear central framing guide for the receipt. Top bar (glass): Close on left, Flash on right. Bottom: One-tap circular capture button.

screens.name: ReviewOCR
screens.purpose: Review and edit data extracted from the receipt before saving.
screens.layout: Single-column form. Top: selected market. Middle: list of extracted products (Name, Qty, Unit [Kg/Un], Price). Bottom: Sticky primary CTA 'Save Purchase' in KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Markets

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'Add your first market'.

screens.layout: Grid or List of favorite supermarkets. Each card has a brandTertiary tinted icon container. 'Add Market' button at top or FAB.

screens.name: Reports
screens.purpose: Visualize spending habits across markets and categories.
screens.layout: Time range selector at top (glass pinned). Category-colored spending donut chart and a bar chart of spending by Market. Clean, legible axes.

screens.name: CurrencySelector
screens.purpose: Select the preferred currency (PYG, USD, EUR, BRL, ARS).
screens.layout: Bottom sheet or modal. Clean list rows (currency code, full name, flag/symbol). Active currency gets a checkmark and brandPrimary tint.

login_hero.alt: Variety of fresh fruits and vegetables on white background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No blues, purples, or indigos. Use the #059669 green for all primary brand actions.
Ensure 'Plus Jakarta Sans' is loaded and used consistently for both text and display, capping weight at 500.
Implement the gradient scrim (transparent to ≥80% surfaceInverse) on the login screen image so the white text is readable.
For the camera scanner, use expo-camera in a full-screen view with a visible receipt-bounding frame for user guidance.
Currency must default to PYG (Guaraní). Use a highly readable numeric layout in Dashboards similar to Robinhood/Cash App (large display size, tight letter spacing).
List items (markets, products) must have a 56pt minimum tappable height.
